newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: DE BEERS CHAIRMAN TO RETIRE AT END OF YEAR.
newsitem.headline: DE BEERS CHAIRMAN TO RETIRE AT END OF YEAR.

text.p: De Beers Consolidated Mines Ltd chairman Julian Ogilvie Thompson on Tuesday announced his retirement at the end of 1997.
"I believe that it is appropriate that I should step down as chairman at the end of this year," Thompson told a news conference.
He would be replaced by De Beers current deputy chairman Nicky Oppenheimer.
"The company has excellent management teams here, in London and elsewhere and under Nicky's leadership I believe the company can approach the new century with confidence and optimism," Thompson said.
He added that he had accepted Oppenheimer's request to take on the position of deputy chairman.

Oppenheimer, who is also chairman of De Beers' selling arm the Central Selling Organisation, is a third generation member of the family which Thompson said had guided De Beers successfully for more than 70 years.
